ordinals: Coordinates are logical x, y, width, height. Both screens are 3 physical pixels per unit. Ink bounds marked Px are in original pixels.
scope: Selected application controls from signed native accessibility observations. OS identifiers, executable locations, account data, generated request IDs and test-device identifiers are excluded.
